'''Highperch''' is an elevated western area of the [[Thousand Needles]] [[zone]]. It is home to the proud Highperch [[wyvern]]s and their nests, and occasionally a mighty wyvern, [[Heartrazor (mob)|Heartrazor]], can be found here. Sometimes, members of the [[Horde]] come to take the eggs to be tamed as [[Wind Rider]] mounts.
